description_en: Queries the downstream nodes of a node. The query results can be used as a data reference when you create a data backfill workflow
description_zh: 查询节点下游，创建补数据工作流时可以作为数据参考
name: ListNodeDownStream

parameters.description_en: The request for querying node downstream.

element_fields.description_en: The list of field IDs. This parameter can be specified when the node ID is a logical table node ID. If this parameter is not specified, all fields in the table are used by default.
element_fields.description_zh: 字段ID列表：当节点是逻辑表节点ID时可以传，不传默认是全表
